item.title: Joe Buck joins father in winning presitigous broadcasting award
item.description: History made in baseball broadcasting (cut) Joe Buck has won the Ford C. Frick Award for baseball broadcasting excellence from the National Baseball Hall of Fame, making him and his father, Jack Buck, the first father-son duo to receive the honor. He will be recognized during the 2026 Hall of Fame induction weekend in Cooperstown. The post Joe Buck joins father in winning presitigous broadcasting award appeared first on Ozark Radio News.

item.title: Missouri Offensive Lineman makes high school history
item.description: Nixa High School’s Jackson Cantwell has been named the 2025-26 Gatorade National Football Player of the Year, becoming the first offensive lineman ever to win the honor. (cut) The 6-foot-8, 305-pound senior shares this honor with players like Emmitt Smith and Peyton Manning. item.title: West Plains to Mail Required EPA Lead and Copper Rule Notices Next Week
item.description: WEST PLAINS, Mo. – The City of West Plains will mail federally required service line notification letters to water customers next week as part of ongoing compliance with the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency’s Lead and Copper Rule.
